name: pushword/twigstan
description: Twig template static analysis for Pushword CMS: catch missing variables and type errors with TwigStan and PHPStan in CI.

suggest.pushword/docs: Pushword documentation, readable offline from vendor/.
suggest.pushword/page-scanner: Check rendered pages for broken links, redirects and TODO reminders.
suggest.pushword/snippet: Reusable content fragments and dev-registered Twig components.
suggest.pushword/static-generator: Export the whole site as static files (GitHub Pages, Apache, FrankenPHP).
suggest.pushword/template-editor: Edit Twig view files online from the admin.
